title: DECISION: Hash verification before blob store write to prevent cache pollution
description: verify_and_store (peer_fetch.rs:475-499) computes SHA-256 and rejects mismatched bodies before writing to disk. Wrong hash → blob never written, local cache not polluted. Test oracle is offline-computed (echo -n 'test blob content' | sha256sum), not self-certifying. This prevents DoS via corrupted attachments and ensures download caching is safe.
